messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: document management system (iManage) - Sat 23 May
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleague,

The firm's document management system (iManage) and remote desktop will be unavailable this Saturday 23 May from 06:00 to 12:00 BST for scheduled maintenance and security patching. Please check in any open documents before Friday close.

No action is required other than saving your work. Apologies for any inconvenience.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
